bifrost: none for CryptoTokenKit; closest adjacent code is springboard/sdk/src/keychain.rs and springboard/src/keychain.rs (generic-password keychain only)
summary: CryptoTokenKit covers smart cards, token drivers and token authentication, none of which BifrOSt has. The repo has no smart card, PC/SC, token driver or token registration code. The app keychain stores only generic passwords and does not handle keys, certificates or tokens.

features.note: Wave 3 (w3-cryptotokenkit, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No smart card reader enumeration or slot handling. Repo-wide search for pcsc, smartcard, ccid and token terms finds no code.

Tied to Apple NFC hardware sessions. No BifrOSt counterpart is sensible.

Wave 3 (w3-cryptotokenkit, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No CryptoTokenKit error domain. The keychain error type covers generic-password results only.

gaps: No smart card reader or slot layer (PC/SC equivalent) in springboard/src/bare/ or anywhere else in the repo.
No token driver or app extension mechanism for hardware tokens.
No way to store, list or use keys or certificates held by a token (keychain is generic-password only, per docs/bifrost-ui.md 'Keychain' section).
No token-based login or two-factor factor for springboard/src/shell/login.rs.
No token registration or managed-device policy for token authentication.
No persistent or HSM token support.
